name: tmux-pair
description: Coordinate one or more coding agents on a task via tmux + git worktrees. /run is the auto-entry: it inspects the repo + task and recommends the right mode (solo for self-contained work; spawn for bigger features). /solo runs a single agent with a gated 6-phase self-review. /spawn runs a coordinated team of orchestrator + ONE writer + reviewers, sized via --size 3..4 (3 = 1W/1R/1O default; 4 = 1W/2R/1O dual-review). Parallel work happens via subagent-worktrees the writer spawns from its Task tool (one Sub-WT per parallel plan-bullet, FF-merge back to feature-WT, squash-merge feature->main at GATE-3-PASS). Includes a 5-gate workflow (Clarify, Reviewer-Readiness with rules-bootstrap loop, Plan-Check, Implementation Loop, Final-Verify), mandatory PROJECT.md care, explicit parallel markers in plans, scoped plugin-agents for the gates (reviewer-readiness-check + rules-bootstrap on Sonnet, gate-2-plan-check on Sonnet, gate-3-verifier on Haiku, gate-3-code-reviewer on Sonnet, RECON via built-in Explore on Haiku), shipped rules templates for 7 stacks (Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, JavaScript, Java, generic), bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), durable standards via claude --append-system-prompt-file + codex AGENTS.md, --effort flag in boot-command, model-aware compact-watcher with /compact [focus] support, dual-review consolidation when reviewers >= 2. Default model claude-opus-4-7 (1M context, override per spawn via --claude-model + --claude-effort + --codex-effort + --reviewer-claude-effort + --reviewer-codex-effort). Default role assignments: writer + orchestrator = claude, reviewers = codex. Reviewer panes always boot at the harness top reasoning tier (claude xhigh, codex high) decoupled from writer/orchestrator budget so review quality stays high. Built-in pi support as third coding agent (the users Custom-CLI at ~/.pi/agent/, default cortecs/qwen3-coder-next; Anthropic-Subscription via pi-claude-bridge with --pi-provider claude-bridge --pi-model claude-opus-4-7).

interface.shortDescription: Spawn tmux solos and coordinated agent teams (size 3..4, single writer) with gated reviews and subagent-worktree fan-out
interface.longDescription: Run solo (single agent + gated 6-phase self-review) or spawn (coordinated team of orchestrator + ONE writer + reviewers, sized 3..4 via --size) agent workflows in tmux with fresh git worktrees, review gates, PROJECT.md care, sender identity prefixes, parallel-plan markers, bundled skills, and helper scripts. Parallel work happens via subagent-worktrees the writer spawns; FF-merge back per subagent, squash-merge feature->main at GATE-3-PASS. /run auto-recommends solo vs spawn from a short repo + task recon. Defaults stay slim, with standard/greenfield briefing extras available via --with-standards and --greenfield.
defaultPrompt: Use /run to pick solo vs spawn for this task.
Spawn a solo agent with gated self-review on this task.
Spawn a coordinated team for this feature (size 3 default, 4-5 for parallel-friendly bullets).
Use tmux-pair orchestration for this repo.
